ordering.candidateOrder: serialized commands[] order, then each infos[] order; preserve duplicates; no additional sort
ordering.distance: CalcDistance(endPosition - startPosition), where negative values add 8; select info.distance equal to that value
ordering.commandRotation: For startPosition 3–6, swap only < and >; keep all other commands unchanged
ordering.points: SlidePathData.points kept in serialized order and are not rotated per start position
